lines.en: I walk slowly over the savanna.

lines.zh: 我的长角很沉，头压得低。
lines.en: My long horns are heavy; my head rides low.
Dry grass, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 角的尖端几乎碰到地面。
lines.en: My horn tips nearly touch the ground.
I head for the waterhole.
My tail swats flies.

lines.zh: 我跨过干沟，角差点碰到地。
lines.en: I step over a dry ditch, horns near the ground.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像拉车的牛。
lines.en: I plod like an ox at a cart.
Seed clings to my legs.
I pause at the fence.
I turn slowly into the sun.
I lower my head to smell the roots.
I walk toward the herd.

lines.zh: 长角晃动时，影子也在晃。
lines.en: My horns sway; so does the shadow.

lines.zh: 我站着，把草又嚼了一遍。
lines.en: I stand and chew the grass a second time.
A small bird lands on my horn.
I blink away the flies.
The wind here is dry.

lines.zh: 我鼻子里喷出两道白气。
lines.en: Two white puffs come from my nostrils.

lines.zh: 角尖磕在木桩上，咚一声。
lines.en: My horn taps the fence post with a thud.
I stare at the lone tree far off.

lines.zh: 这一片草，够我嚼到天黑。
lines.en: This patch will last me until dark.
I lie in the dry grass, chewing slowly.

lines.zh: 我背上的毛被晒得发烫。
lines.en: The fur on my back grows hot in the sun.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地嚼，一下又一下。
lines.en: I chew, slow and steady.
The herd is quiet beside me.
My ear flicks.
Flies again. My tail answers.
I wait for the milking.
Dry roots are still food.
I look up at the sky.

lines.zh: 角太重，我很少抬得很高。
lines.en: My horns are heavy. I rarely lift high.
Grass in your hand?
The horns are not for grabbing.
You stand a little taller.

lines.zh: 你从后面靠近，我后蹄不安。
lines.en: Approaching from behind makes my hind hoof restless.
You smell of milk.
I know milking hands.
I know the hands that milk.
These horns open wooden fences.

lines.zh: 你手里那根绳子，我不喜欢。
lines.en: I dislike that rope.
Back off and I keep grazing.
Little startles me here.
You may touch. Not from behind.
My horns face forward, not you.
I smell the grass you hold.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口鼻息，算打招呼。
lines.en: I snort once by way of greeting.
Back off and we get along.

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，退了两步。
lines.en: I low and back off twice.

lines.zh: 牛皮厚，角旁还是开了口。
lines.en: Thick hide, split by the horn.
I shake my head; horns hit the rail.
A chip in my horn.

lines.zh: 我把整个身子慢慢调过来。
lines.en: I swing my whole bulk around.
Little blood. It does not matter.
I keep chewing.
Flies gather at once.
I do not cry out. Cattle rarely do.
That makes me warier.
Grass? That I want.
Hold it by my horns and I can reach.
That handful is too dry.
I eat grass, not bread.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，角可能就掉了。
lines.en: Ram me and a horn may come off.
This grass is tender enough to drip.

lines.zh: 你手里那束草，还带着露水。
lines.en: The grass in your hand still has dew on it.
Do not shake it. It falls.

lines.zh: 你手里的草，只够我嚼一下。
lines.en: That handful is barely one chew.
Hold it and I will follow.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的侧面，弹了回去。
lines.en: You hit my flank and bounced.
I am a wall with horns.
I shift; my horns sweep past.
Not in front of the horn tips.
Heavy. You cannot shove me.
After the bump, I keep chewing.

lines.zh: 我低头把角让开，你过去。
lines.en: I lower my horns to let you pass.
The horn brushed without force.
My horn hit the rail.
Go around the horns.
The herd bull handles that.
These horns grew for that.
Nobody in the herd asks that.
I rank mid-herd.
Don't ask. I'm chewing grass.
I mind grass and cud.
Horn fights are loud.
Horn fights in the herd could hit you.

lines.zh: 这话题，我甩尾就过去了。
lines.en: My tail flicks it away.
I lower my head. No talking.
This grass rolls into my mouth.
I kick your fallen thing aside.
My tongue wraps the grass.

lines.zh: 格挡我一次，我的角就掉。
lines.en: Block my charge once, and a horn drops.
Something is caught on my horn.
I eat the roots too.
The rope is tangled around my hoof.
No scent to this.
Pick it up; my hooves stay put.

lines.zh: 我把它拨到一边，继续吃。
lines.en: I push it aside and graze.

lines.zh: 我把整副角放低，对准你。
lines.en: I bring the whole horn rack down on you.
You are in front of my horns.
My long horns have lowered.
I do not plan to stop.
My horns are aimed at the wooden fence.

lines.zh: 长角牛冲起来，尾巴先竖。
lines.en: A longhorn's tail rises before the charge.
No one comes to help here.
I low, deep.
Horn tips at your chest.
This charge goes straight.
I lower my horns and press forward.
My horns part the grass.
My hooves paw at the dry earth.
I track where you stand.
My hooves pack the ground.

lines.zh: 你听见蹄子刨地的声音吗？
lines.en: Hear the hooves pawing?
I trot. Steady.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住角。
lines.en: That will not stop horns.
Two steps left. Head down.
Now the horns land.
My horn tip drives into your armor.
That knocks you two blocks back.
My hooves stamp; earth sprays.
I swing my head; horns clip your shoulder.
You stop the horns and lose a step.
Blunt, and heavy.
I back off two steps and lower my horns again.
Your armor makes a cracking sound.
That shook me too.
You were not knocked flat.
One more in the herd.
Long horns show above the grass.

lines.zh: 牛角先出树影，我才露头。
lines.en: My horns leave the tree's shadow before I do.
A path pressed in the dry grass.

lines.zh: 你听见一声低沉的哞吗？
lines.en: Hear that low?
My long horns swing with a dull knock.
Enough grass here for me.
I stand by the fence.
The herd drifts this way.

lines.zh: 蝇子绕着我，我慢慢踱来。
lines.en: Flies circle me as I amble in.
I lower my head and graze.
This ground is ours.

lines.zh: 火苗舔过脊背，我猛地转身。
lines.en: Flames lick my spine; I wheel around.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，站不起来。
lines.en: I slide down the slope and cannot rise.
Water to my belly. I stall.

lines.zh: 我的角扎进土里，才没翻。
lines.en: My horn dug into the soil and kept me upright.
My horns can be made into an instrument.

lines.zh: 紫色光缠住腿，我差点跪了。
lines.en: Purple light wraps my legs; I nearly kneel.

lines.zh: 没有草，我瘦得看得见骨头。
lines.en: No grass and my ribs show.
Thunder startles the whole herd.

lines.zh: 脚下草地塌了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The ground gives and I fall.
